blocks.zh: 製造要求（下）：充填、目視檢查與最終包裝
blocks.en: Manufacturing Requirements (Part 2): Filling, Visual Inspection, and Final Packaging

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解預充填注射器（Prefilled Syringe）的充填製程——包含預滅菌注射器與散裝注射器兩種路徑的關鍵步驟差異
blocks.en: Understand the filling process for prefilled syringes, including the key differences between the presterilized-syringe and bulk-syringe routes

blocks.zh: 掌握活塞橡膠塞（Plunger Stopper）三種插入方法的原理與適用時機
blocks.en: Master the principles and applicable situations of the three plunger stopper insertion methods

blocks.zh: 了解散裝注射器的清洗、矽化、裝配針套與滅菌等前處理步驟
blocks.en: Understand the pre-treatment steps for bulk syringes: washing, siliconization, needle shield assembly, and sterilization

blocks.zh: 認識目視檢查（Visual Inspection）的缺陷分類體系與半自動/全自動檢查的差異
blocks.en: Understand the defect classification system for visual inspection and the differences between semiautomated and fully automated inspection

blocks.zh: 掌握最終組裝與二次包裝（標籤、泡殼、裝箱、序列化）的完整流程與法規考量
blocks.en: Master the complete final assembly and secondary packaging flow (labeling, blistering, cartoning, serialization) and its regulatory considerations

blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Presterilized Syringes (預滅菌注射器)：這是目前最主流的預充填注射器充填方式。注射器由供應商在潔淨室中完成清洗、矽化、滅菌，然後以 tub/nest 形式（盤/巢架）供貨。充填廠只需要「開蓋、取出、充填、塞塞、放回」，大幅簡化製程。
blocks.en: Presterilized Syringes: This is currently the most common filling approach for prefilled syringes. The supplier washes, siliconizes, and sterilizes the syringes in a cleanroom and delivers them in tub/nest format. The filling site only needs to "open the lid, remove, fill, stopper, and return," which greatly simplifies the process.

blocks.zh: 三種塞塞方法比較：
blocks.en: Comparison of the three stoppering methods:

blocks.zh: Mechanical Vent Tube（機械通氣管法）：最傳統的方法，以推桿將橡膠塞壓入通氣管，再藉管內通道排出空氣。精確度高但需要專用規格件。
blocks.en: Mechanical Vent Tube: The most traditional method. A plunger rod pushes the stopper into a vent tube, and air escapes through the channel inside the tube. Accuracy is high, but dedicated, specially sized parts are required.

blocks.zh: Vacuum Insertion Tub（真空插入槽法）：先抽真空再推塞，橡膠塞藉真空力滑入最終位置。
blocks.en: Vacuum Insertion Tub: A vacuum is drawn first and then the stopper is pushed in, so the stopper slides to its final position under vacuum force.

blocks.zh: Vacuum Bell（真空鐘罩法）：完全靠真空吸力拉入橡膠塞，無推桿，主要用於 nested stopper（巢式橡膠塞）。
blocks.en: Vacuum Bell: The stopper is drawn in entirely by vacuum suction with no plunger rod; it is used mainly with nested stoppers.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 整個 tub/nest 充填流程就像「開盒飯、加菜、蓋蓋子、放回便當盒」：先撕開 Tyvek 密封膜（開蓋），從巢架取出注射器（拿出便當盒），充填藥液（加菜），塞入橡膠塞（蓋蓋子），最後放回巢架和外盤（放回）。整個過程中注射器始終「坐在」巢架裡，不需要逐支搬運，這就是 nest format 的最大優勢。
blocks.en: The whole tub/nest filling process is like "opening a lunch box, adding the food, putting the lid on, and putting it back in the carrier": first peel off the Tyvek seal (open the lid), take the syringes out of the nest (take out the lunch boxes), fill the drug solution (add the food), insert the stoppers (put the lids on), and finally return everything to the nest and outer tub (put it back). Throughout the process the syringes stay "seated" in the nest and do not need to be handled one by one, which is the biggest advantage of the nest format.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: Nitrogen Overlay（氮氣覆蓋）：對氧氣敏感的生物藥品（如單株抗體），在充填和塞塞過程中覆蓋氮氣可以有效排除頭空間（headspace）中的氧氣，避免氧化降解。這是一項 CQA 相關的製程控制。
blocks.en: Nitrogen Overlay: For oxygen-sensitive biologics (such as monoclonal antibodies), a nitrogen overlay during filling and stoppering effectively removes oxygen from the headspace and prevents oxidative degradation. This is a CQA-related process control.

blocks.zh: 充填精度：充填體積準確度必須經過充分特性化。對預充填注射器而言，過多藥液可能導致塞塞困難或洩漏，過少則不符合標示量。不同泵浦系統（蠕動泵、旋轉活塞泵、時間壓力系統等）各有精度與適用範圍差異。
blocks.en: Fill accuracy: Fill volume accuracy must be thoroughly characterized. For prefilled syringes, too much solution can cause stoppering difficulties or leakage, while too little fails the labeled volume. Different pump systems (peristaltic pumps, rotary piston pumps, time-pressure systems, etc.) differ in accuracy and range of application.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Vacuum Bell 方法主要用於 nested stoppers？若用於非 nested 的橡膠塞，可能會遇到什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why is the vacuum bell method used mainly with nested stoppers? What problems might arise if it is used with non-nested stoppers?

blocks.zh: 若生產的藥品對氧化極為敏感，除了 Nitrogen overlay，還能從哪些製程環節降低氧暴露？
blocks.en: If the product is extremely sensitive to oxidation, besides a nitrogen overlay, at which other process steps could oxygen exposure be reduced?

blocks.zh: 13.3 Filling of Bulk Syringes 13.3 散裝注射筒充填
blocks.en: 13.3 Filling of Bulk Syringes

blocks.zh: Bulk Syringes（散裝注射器）vs Presterilized Syringes（預滅菌注射器）：
blocks.en: Bulk Syringes vs Presterilized Syringes:

blocks.zh: 散裝注射器：充填廠自行完成清洗、矽化、裝針套、滅菌等所有前處理步驟。優點是製程控制權完全掌握在廠內，可依產品需求客製化；缺點是需要大量專業知識（subject matter expertise）、設備投資與 GMP 空間。
blocks.en: Bulk syringes: The filling site performs all pre-treatment steps itself: washing, siliconization, needle shield assembly, and sterilization. The advantage is full in-house control of the process, which can be tailored to product needs; the disadvantages are the need for substantial subject matter expertise, equipment investment, and GMP floor space.

blocks.zh: 預滅菌注射器：由供應商完成前處理，以 RTU（Ready-to-Use，即用型）形式供貨。充填廠省去洗瓶、矽化、滅菌等步驟，但對供應商品質的依賴度更高。
blocks.en: Presterilized syringes: The supplier performs the pre-treatment and delivers the syringes in RTU (Ready-to-Use) form. The filling site is spared washing, siliconization, and sterilization, but depends more heavily on supplier quality.

blocks.zh: CCI（Container Closure Integrity，容器密封完整性）：裝配針套時若刺穿針套，將破壞無菌屏障，這是一個直接影響無菌保證（Sterility Assurance）的關鍵風險點。
blocks.en: CCI (Container Closure Integrity): If the needle shield is punctured during assembly, the sterile barrier is breached. This is a critical risk point that directly affects sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 散裝注射器與預滅菌注射器的差異，就像「自己從生麵開始做拉麵」vs「買現成的冷凍拉麵包加熱」。散裝路線（自己做）給你完全的控制權——麵粉比例、含水量、粗細都能調整——但你需要有和麵、擀麵、拉麵的全套技術和設備。預滅菌路線（冷凍包）則只需要一口鍋（充填線），但你完全仰賴供應商的麵條品質。
blocks.en: The difference between bulk and presterilized syringes is like "making ramen from scratch" vs "buying a ready-made frozen ramen pack and heating it." The bulk route (making it yourself) gives you full control (flour ratio, water content, and thickness can all be adjusted), but you need the complete skills and equipment for mixing, rolling, and pulling the noodles. The presterilized route (the frozen pack) needs only a pot (the filling line), but you rely entirely on the supplier for noodle quality.

blocks.zh: 潔淨度等級與環境控制：
blocks.en: Cleanliness grades and environmental control:

blocks.zh: 清洗/矽化/裝針套：通常在 Grade C + 層流下進行
blocks.en: Washing/siliconization/needle shield assembly: usually performed in Grade C with unidirectional airflow

blocks.zh: 充填：Grade A 層流 + Grade B 背景（傳統 RABS），或 Grade A（隔離器）+ Grade C 背景
blocks.en: Filling: Grade A unidirectional airflow with a Grade B background (conventional RABS), or Grade A (isolator) with a Grade C background

blocks.zh: 滅菌：在 Grade C 環境下自動化轉運至蒸汽滅菌釜
blocks.en: Sterilization: automated transfer in a Grade C environment to the steam sterilizer

blocks.zh: 鎢殘留（Tungsten Residue）：玻璃注射器成型時使用鎢針來形成針孔，可能殘留微量鎢。某些蛋白質藥物對鎢敏感，清洗步驟需要特別關注此殘留物。
blocks.en: Tungsten Residue: Tungsten pins are used to form the needle channel when glass syringes are molded and may leave trace tungsten residue. Some protein drugs are sensitive to tungsten, so the washing steps need special attention to this residue.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 若你是 CDMO，客戶的生物藥品（mAb）每年需求量僅 5 萬支預充填注射器，你會推薦散裝路線還是預滅菌路線？考慮因素：
blocks.en: If you are a CDMO and a client's biologic (mAb) requires only 50,000 prefilled syringes per year, would you recommend the bulk route or the presterilized route? Considerations:

blocks.zh: 5 萬支/年屬中小批量，散裝路線的設備攤提成本偏高
blocks.en: 50,000 units/year is a small-to-medium batch volume, so the equipment amortization cost of the bulk route is high

blocks.zh: 預滅菌 RTU 注射器的單價較高，但省去清洗/矽化/滅菌設備投資
blocks.en: Presterilized RTU syringes have a higher unit price, but avoid the capital investment in washing/siliconization/sterilization equipment

blocks.zh: mAb 對鎢殘留可能敏感——若用散裝路線，清洗驗證範圍需涵蓋鎢
blocks.en: mAbs may be sensitive to tungsten residue; with the bulk route, the cleaning validation scope must cover tungsten

blocks.zh: 結論：中小批量通常傾向預滅菌路線，以降低資本支出與複雜度
blocks.en: Conclusion: small-to-medium volumes generally favor the presterilized route to reduce capital expenditure and complexity

blocks.zh: 為什麼 vacuum stoppering 對高黏度藥液特別有利？提示：想想空氣泡的壓力緩衝效應對黏稠液體推注的影響。
blocks.en: Why is vacuum stoppering particularly advantageous for high-viscosity solutions? Hint: think about how the pressure-buffering effect of an air bubble affects pushing a viscous liquid.

blocks.zh: 如果滅菌過程中針套鬆脫，可能造成什麼品質風險？後續應如何偵測並處理？
blocks.en: If the needle shield comes loose during sterilization, what quality risks could result? How should this be detected and handled afterward?

blocks.zh: 比較散裝與預滅菌路線的 TCO（總擁有成本），哪些隱性成本容易被忽略？
blocks.en: Compare the TCO (total cost of ownership) of the bulk and presterilized routes. Which hidden costs are easily overlooked?

blocks.zh: 13.4 Visual Inspection 13.4 目視檢查
blocks.en: 13.4 Visual Inspection

blocks.zh: Visual Inspection（目視檢查）：注射劑的目視檢查是法規強制要求的製程步驟。根據歐洲藥典（EP）Section 2.9.20 與 USP <790>，所有注射用製劑必須進行 100% 的目視檢查，以偵測可見微粒（visible particles）與容器缺陷。
blocks.en: Visual Inspection: Visual inspection of injectables is a mandatory process step. Under Ph. Eur. (EP) Section 2.9.20 and USP <790>, all parenteral preparations must undergo 100% visual inspection to detect visible particles and container defects.

blocks.zh: Defect Library（缺陷圖庫）：這是目視檢查的基礎工具，包含所有已知缺陷的照片與描述。檢查人員的訓練、資格認定、以及日常挑戰測試（challenge test）都以此為基準。缺陷圖庫需要持續更新，納入新發現的缺陷類型。
blocks.en: Defect Library: This is the foundation tool for visual inspection, containing photographs and descriptions of all known defects. Inspector training, qualification, and daily challenge tests are all based on it. The defect library must be continuously updated to include newly found defect types.

blocks.zh: 缺陷分類體系：
blocks.en: Defect classification system:

blocks.zh: Critical defects（關鍵缺陷）：可能直接危害病患安全，如異物、無充填、裂痕等——零容忍
blocks.en: Critical defects: Defects that could directly endanger patient safety, such as foreign matter, no fill, or cracks; zero tolerance

blocks.zh: Major defects（主要缺陷）：影響產品功能或效能，如充填量偏高/偏低、橡膠塞歪斜
blocks.en: Major defects: Defects that affect product function or performance, such as high/low fill volume or a tilted stopper

blocks.zh: Minor defects（次要缺陷）：外觀瑕疵但不影響安全或功能，如輕微刮痕
blocks.en: Minor defects: Cosmetic flaws that do not affect safety or function, such as light scratches

blocks.zh: 目視檢查就像「機場安檢」——每一個「旅客」（注射器）都必須過關，任何攜帶「違禁品」（缺陷）的都要被攔下來。缺陷圖庫就是安檢人員的「違禁品辨識手冊」。訓練越充分、手冊越完整，漏檢率就越低。
blocks.en: Visual inspection is like "airport security": every "passenger" (syringe) must pass, and anyone carrying "contraband" (a defect) is stopped. The defect library is the screeners' "contraband identification manual." The better the training and the more complete the manual, the lower the miss rate.

blocks.zh: 溫度平衡至關重要：如果注射器從冷藏狀態直接進入檢查室，外壁會凝結水珠，嚴重干擾目視判讀。因此必須留足夠時間讓注射器回溫至室溫（ambient temperature）。這是一個看似簡單但常被忽略的品質風險點。
blocks.en: Temperature equilibration is critical: If syringes go straight from cold storage into the inspection room, condensation forms on the outer wall and seriously interferes with visual assessment. Enough time must therefore be allowed for syringes to warm to ambient temperature. This is a quality risk point that looks simple but is often overlooked.

blocks.zh: 檢查人員疲勞管理：人工目視檢查極度依賴操作員的專注力。法規要求定期輪換、休息，且每位檢查員每次連續檢查時間有上限。這也是為什麼自動化檢查越來越受青睞的原因之一。
blocks.en: Inspector fatigue management: Manual visual inspection depends heavily on the operator's concentration. Regulations expect regular rotation and breaks, and a limit on how long each inspector may inspect continuously. This is one reason automated inspection is increasingly favored.

blocks.zh: 為什麼「橡膠塞上下顛倒（upside-down）」被歸類為缺陷？這會對 CCI 或藥液接觸面造成什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why is an "upside-down stopper" classified as a defect? How does it affect CCI or the product-contact surface?

blocks.zh: 如果一批次中某類缺陷的拒收率突然升高，應啟動什麼調查流程？
blocks.en: If the rejection rate for one type of defect suddenly rises within a batch, what investigation process should be initiated?

blocks.zh: 13.4.1 Semiautomated Visual Inspection 13.4.1 半自動目視檢查
blocks.en: 13.4.1 Semiautomated Visual Inspection

blocks.zh: Semiautomated Visual Inspection（半自動目視檢查）：結合機械自動化（自動脫巢、輸送）與人工判讀的混合模式。自動化處理「搬運」環節，讓操作員專注於「檢查」本身，提升效率。
blocks.en: Semiautomated Visual Inspection: A hybrid mode combining mechanical automation (automatic denesting and conveying) with human judgment. Automation handles the "handling" step so operators can concentrate on the inspection itself, improving efficiency.

blocks.zh: 注射器在輸送帶上以固定速率移動，操作員觀察後將不合格品手動撥入拒收軌道。這比純手動檢查快，但仍受限於操作員的判讀速度與疲勞。
blocks.en: Syringes move along a conveyor at a fixed speed, and the operator manually diverts rejects into a reject track after observing them. This is faster than purely manual inspection but is still limited by the operator's judgment speed and fatigue.

blocks.zh: 半自動模式的輸送速率（conveyor speed）必須經過驗證，確保操作員有足夠時間觀察每支注射器。速率過快會增加漏檢率（miss rate）。許多法規檢查機構會特別關注輸送速率設定與操作員資格認定的關聯。
blocks.en: The conveyor speed of a semiautomated mode must be validated to ensure the operator has enough time to observe each syringe. Excessive speed increases the miss rate. Many regulatory inspectors pay particular attention to the link between conveyor speed settings and operator qualification.

blocks.zh: 13.4.2 Automated Visual Inspection 13.4.2 自動化目視檢查
blocks.en: 13.4.2 Automated Visual Inspection

blocks.zh: Automated Visual Inspection（全自動目視檢查）：以機器視覺系統（vision system）取代人眼，透過高速相機、照明控制與影像演算法自動偵測缺陷。優勢包括：
blocks.en: Automated Visual Inspection: A machine vision system replaces the human eye, detecting defects automatically through high-speed cameras, lighting control, and image algorithms. Advantages include:

blocks.zh: 速度遠高於人工（可達每分鐘數百支）
blocks.en: Much faster than manual inspection (up to several hundred units per minute)

blocks.zh: 不受疲勞影響，一致性高
blocks.en: Unaffected by fatigue, with high consistency

blocks.zh: 可依缺陷類型自動分類與統計
blocks.en: Automatic classification and statistics by defect type

blocks.zh: 可與上下游（充填線、包裝線）無縫串接
blocks.en: Seamless integration with upstream and downstream equipment (filling line, packaging line)

blocks.zh: AQL Inspection（驗收品質水準檢驗）：即使使用全自動檢查，仍需以人工 AQL 抽樣複檢來確認機器在合格狀態下運行。這是「機器驗證人」+「人驗證機器」的雙重品質保障。
blocks.en: AQL Inspection (Acceptable Quality Level): Even with fully automated inspection, a manual AQL sampling re-inspection is still needed to confirm that the machine is operating in a qualified state. This provides dual quality assurance: "the machine verifies the human" and "the human verifies the machine."

blocks.zh: 全自動目視檢查就像「高速公路的自動測速照相」——每輛車（注射器）高速通過時都被拍照並即時判讀。但系統每天上班前要先用「已知超速」的測試車來校準（defect library challenge），確認照相機正常運作。而且定期還是要派交警（AQL 人工抽檢）上路抽查，確保系統沒有漏網之魚。
blocks.en: Fully automated visual inspection is like "automatic speed cameras on a highway": every car (syringe) passing at high speed is photographed and judged in real time. But before each day's operation the system must be calibrated with a test car of "known speeding" (defect library challenge) to confirm the camera works properly. And traffic police (manual AQL sampling) must still be sent out regularly for spot checks to make sure nothing slips through.

blocks.zh: 生物藥品的特殊考量：
blocks.en: Special considerations for biologics:

blocks.zh: Spinning（旋轉）：自動檢查機通常讓注射器高速旋轉以偵測懸浮微粒。但某些蛋白質藥物在剪切力下可能形成聚集體（aggregates）或泡沫，影響判讀。
blocks.en: Spinning: Automated inspection machines usually spin syringes at high speed to detect suspended particles. However, some protein drugs may form aggregates or foam under shear force, which interferes with assessment.

blocks.zh: Photo-exposure（光照）：強光源可能促進光敏感蛋白質的降解。
blocks.en: Photo-exposure: Strong light sources may promote degradation of light-sensitive proteins.

blocks.zh: Heat（熱）：設備運行產生的熱量可能使溫度敏感的生物藥品品質劣化。
blocks.en: Heat: Heat generated by equipment operation may degrade temperature-sensitive biologics.

blocks.zh: 因此，在設備規格設計階段就必須評估這些因素對特定產品的影響。利用安定性數據（stability data）進行理論估算或實際試車是業界推薦的做法。
blocks.en: Therefore, the impact of these factors on the specific product must be evaluated at the equipment specification design stage. Using stability data for theoretical estimates or running actual trials is the recommended industry practice.

blocks.zh: 假設你的 CDMO 正在評估是否為預充填注射器產線投資全自動目視檢查機（約 200-500 萬美元），以下是決策要點：
blocks.en: Suppose your CDMO is evaluating whether to invest in a fully automated visual inspection machine (approx. USD 2-5 million) for a prefilled syringe line. Key decision points:

blocks.zh: 產能門檻：通常年產量超過 500 萬支時，全自動的效率優勢才能有效攤提投資
blocks.en: Capacity threshold: Generally, the efficiency advantage of full automation amortizes the investment effectively only when annual output exceeds 5 million units

blocks.zh: 產品組合：若同時服務多家客戶的不同產品，需考慮 changeover 時間與缺陷圖庫管理複雜度
blocks.en: Product mix: If you serve multiple clients with different products, consider changeover time and the complexity of defect library management

blocks.zh: 法規趨勢：全自動檢查的可追溯性（每支注射器的檢查影像可留存）越來越受法規青睞
blocks.en: Regulatory trend: The traceability of fully automated inspection (inspection images of each syringe can be retained) is increasingly favored by regulators

blocks.zh: 混合策略：許多 CDMO 採用「全自動初篩 + 人工 AQL 複檢」的雙軌模式
blocks.en: Hybrid strategy: Many CDMOs adopt a dual-track model of "automated primary screening + manual AQL re-inspection"

blocks.zh: 為什麼即使有全自動檢查機，仍然需要人工 AQL 抽檢？如果機器的漏檢率已經低於人工，這個要求是否仍有必要？
blocks.en: Why is manual AQL sampling still needed even when a fully automated inspection machine is available? If the machine's miss rate is already lower than that of humans, is this requirement still necessary?

blocks.zh: PDA TR43 與本節內容的關聯為何？為什麼 TR73 會交叉引用 TR43？
blocks.en: How does PDA TR43 relate to the content of this section? Why does TR73 cross-reference TR43?

blocks.zh: 若你的產品是高黏度的 mAb 製劑，在設備選型時最擔心哪個因素——spinning、photo-exposure 還是 heat？為什麼？
blocks.en: If your product is a high-viscosity mAb formulation, which factor worries you most when selecting equipment: spinning, photo-exposure, or heat? Why?

blocks.zh: 13.5 Final Drug Assembly and Product Secondary Packaging 13.5 最終藥品組裝與產品二次包裝
blocks.en: 13.5 Final Drug Assembly and Product Secondary Packaging

blocks.zh: Final Drug Assembly（最終藥品組裝）：包含標籤、推桿桿、後擋等元件的裝配。
blocks.en: Final Drug Assembly: Includes assembly of components such as the label, plunger rod, and backstop.

blocks.zh: Secondary Packaging（二次包裝）：泡殼包裝（blistering）、裝箱（cartoning）等外包裝作業。
blocks.en: Secondary Packaging: Outer packaging operations such as blistering and cartoning.

blocks.zh: 這兩者在大多數產線中是獨立的單元操作（separate unit operations）。只有極高產能的連續生產線才會將充填、檢查、組裝、包裝一氣呵成。
blocks.en: On most production lines these two are separate unit operations. Only very high-capacity continuous lines combine filling, inspection, assembly, and packaging in one flow.

blocks.zh: 這就像汽車製造的「組裝線」與「出廠檢查 + 包裝出貨」是分開的。先把引擎、底盤、車身組裝完成（充填 + 檢查），再進行烤漆、貼標、包膜、裝箱出貨（組裝 + 二次包裝）。小批量客製化車款（小包裝批量）更需要頻繁換線，因此預先暫存（staging）再統一包裝是合理策略。
blocks.en: This is like the "assembly line" in car manufacturing being separate from "final inspection + packing and shipping." The engine, chassis, and body are assembled first (filling + inspection), and then painting, labeling, wrapping, and boxing for shipment follow (assembly + secondary packaging). Small custom batches (small packaging lots) require frequent line changeovers, so staging first and then packaging together is a sensible strategy.

blocks.zh: 市場特殊需求：不同國家/市場可能要求不同語言的標籤、不同規格的包裝配置（如日本市場偏好單支泡殼，歐洲市場可能接受多支裝）。這也是為什麼最終組裝經常要與充填分開——以便依市場需求彈性包裝。
blocks.en: Market-specific requirements: Different countries/markets may require labels in different languages and different pack configurations (for example, the Japanese market prefers single-syringe blisters, while the European market may accept multi-syringe packs). This is also why final assembly is often separated from filling, so packaging can be flexible according to market needs.

blocks.zh: 13.5.1 Labeling, Plunger Rod, and Backstop Placement 13.5.1 標示、推桿與止擋安裝
blocks.en: 13.5.1 Labeling, Plunger Rod, and Backstop Placement

blocks.zh: Plunger Rod Insertion（推桿插入）：1 mL 長型注射器的推桿頂端有螺紋，需旋入橡膠塞的螺紋孔。機器設定的扭力（torque）決定推桿的最終位置。
blocks.en: Plunger Rod Insertion: The tip of the plunger rod of a 1 mL long syringe is threaded and must be screwed into the threaded hole of the stopper. The torque set on the machine determines the final position of the plunger rod.

blocks.zh: Backstop（後擋）：裝在注射器指翼（finger flange）上的配件，一方面擴大握持面積以利注射操作，另一方面防止推桿被意外拉出。
blocks.en: Backstop: An accessory attached to the finger flange of the syringe; it enlarges the gripping area to ease injection and prevents the plunger rod from being pulled out accidentally.

blocks.zh: Lumicode（光碼）：一種自動化品質確認系統，能即時檢測標籤的存在與位置是否正確。
blocks.en: Lumicode: An automated quality verification system that detects in real time whether the label is present and correctly positioned.

blocks.zh: 推桿插入的兩大風險：
blocks.en: Two major risks of plunger rod insertion:

blocks.zh: 風險 1 — 橡膠塞後退：若扭力設定不當，旋入推桿時可能將橡膠塞推回至注射器筒身的非無菌區域，破壞產品無菌性。這是一個直接影響無菌保證的關鍵風險。
blocks.en: Risk 1 - Stopper retraction: If the torque is set improperly, screwing in the plunger rod may push the stopper back into the non-sterile area of the barrel, compromising product sterility. This is a critical risk that directly affects sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 風險 2 — 橡膠塞前移造成超壓：若橡膠塞被推向筒身前端（靠近針頭側），會壓縮藥液空間產生超壓。病患拔除針套時，藥液可能噴出（splashing），造成劑量損失與安全隱患。
blocks.en: Risk 2 - Stopper advancement causing overpressure: If the stopper is pushed toward the front of the barrel (the needle side), it compresses the liquid space and creates overpressure. When the patient removes the needle shield, the solution may splash out, causing dose loss and a safety hazard.

blocks.zh: 因此，扭力參數必須經過精確驗證，確保推桿旋入過程中橡膠塞的移動量最小化。
blocks.en: Torque parameters must therefore be precisely validated to minimize stopper movement during plunger rod insertion.

blocks.zh: 標籤上為什麼需要包含「可變數據」（variable data）區域？如果這些資料在充填前就預印好，會有什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why does a label need to include a "variable data" area? What risks arise if this data is preprinted before filling?

blocks.zh: 推桿扭力過高與過低各會造成什麼後果？你會如何設計驗證方案來確定最佳扭力範圍？
blocks.en: What are the consequences of plunger rod torque that is too high and too low? How would you design a validation program to determine the optimal torque range?

blocks.zh: 13.5.2 Blistering 13.5.2 泡殼包裝
blocks.en: 13.5.2 Blistering

blocks.zh: Thermoformed Blister（熱成型泡殼）：利用加熱軟化塑膠片材後真空成型，形成符合注射器外形的凹槽。常見材質包括：
blocks.en: Thermoformed Blister: Plastic sheet is softened by heating and then vacuum-formed to create cavities that match the syringe shape. Common materials include:

blocks.zh: PVC（聚氯乙烯）：最常見，成本低，成型性佳
blocks.en: PVC (polyvinyl chloride): The most common; low cost and good formability

blocks.zh: PET（聚對苯二甲酸乙二醇酯）：透明度高，環保回收性較佳
blocks.en: PET (polyethylene terephthalate): High clarity and better recyclability

blocks.zh: PP（聚丙烯）：耐化學性、耐熱性較好
blocks.en: PP (polypropylene): Better chemical and heat resistance

blocks.zh: EO Sterilization（環氧乙烷滅菌）：對已密封的泡殼進行 EO 氣體處理，可實現注射器外表面的無菌化。這在需要無菌外包裝的市場（如某些手術套組）中特別重要。
blocks.en: EO Sterilization (ethylene oxide): Treating sealed blisters with EO gas can sterilize the outer surface of the syringe. This is especially important in markets that require sterile outer packaging (such as certain surgical kits).

blocks.zh: 泡殼包裝就像「量身訂製的手機殼 + 貼膜」——泡殼的凹槽完美貼合注射器形狀（防護），覆蓋膜密封住（隔絕外界污染），但又要設計成使用者能輕鬆撕開（易開性）。這個「保護 vs 易開」的平衡是泡殼設計的核心挑戰。
blocks.en: Blister packaging is like a "custom-fit phone case plus screen protector": the blister cavity fits the syringe shape perfectly (protection), and the lidding film seals it (isolation from outside contamination), yet it must be designed so users can peel it open easily (ease of opening). This balance of "protection vs ease of opening" is the core challenge of blister design.

blocks.zh: 空運期間的推桿移動風險：飛機貨艙的氣壓變化可能導致注射器內部壓力失衡，推動橡膠塞移位。若橡膠塞移入非無菌區域，則產品無菌性受損。因此泡殼設計必須固定推桿，防止運輸過程中的移動。這是一個容易被忽略但後果嚴重的包裝設計要點。
blocks.en: Plunger rod movement risk during air transport: Pressure changes in an aircraft cargo hold may unbalance the pressure inside the syringe and push the stopper out of position. If the stopper moves into the non-sterile area, product sterility is compromised. The blister design must therefore secure the plunger rod to prevent movement during transport. This is an easily overlooked packaging design point with serious consequences.

blocks.zh: Clean but Not Classified（受控但非分級）：泡殼包裝通常不在 GMP 分級潔淨室中進行，而是在「受控」環境下操作。這是因為二次包裝不直接接觸藥液，屬於非關鍵操作。
blocks.en: Clean but Not Classified: Blistering is usually not performed in a GMP-classified cleanroom but in a "controlled" environment. This is because secondary packaging does not directly contact the drug solution and is a non-critical operation.

blocks.zh: 為什麼低成本、高頻次給藥產品（如 heparin）傾向多支裝泡殼，而高成本、低頻次產品傾向單支裝？從醫療經濟學角度分析。
blocks.en: Why do low-cost, high-frequency products (such as heparin) tend toward multi-syringe blister packs, while high-cost, low-frequency products tend toward single-syringe packs? Analyze from a health economics perspective.

blocks.zh: Dividella-type packaging 直接將注射器裝入紙盒而不使用泡殼，這種方式的優勢與風險各是什麼？
blocks.en: Dividella-type packaging loads syringes directly into a carton without a blister. What are the advantages and risks of this approach?

blocks.zh: 13.5.3 Cartoning 13.5.3 裝盒
blocks.en: 13.5.3 Cartoning

blocks.zh: Cartoning（裝箱）：自動化裝箱線將泡殼、仿單（patient information leaflet）放入紙盒，同時在線列印批號、有效期限與條碼/資料矩陣碼。
blocks.en: Cartoning: An automated cartoning line places the blister and the patient information leaflet into the carton and prints the lot number, expiry date, and barcode/data matrix code on-line at the same time.

blocks.zh: Data Matrix Code（資料矩陣碼）：相較於傳統條碼（barcode），二維資料矩陣碼可容納更多資訊（如序號、批號、效期），且面積更小，是序列化（serialization）的基礎技術。
blocks.en: Data Matrix Code: Compared with a traditional barcode, a two-dimensional data matrix code can hold more information (such as serial number, lot number, and expiry) in a smaller area, and is the foundational technology for serialization.

blocks.zh: 在線列印（on-line printing）的品質必須經過驗證——墨水的持久性（ink durability）、列印解析度、與包材的相容性都需確認。若條碼或 data matrix 無法正確讀取，將直接影響下游的序列化追蹤與藥品分銷。
blocks.en: The quality of on-line printing must be validated: ink durability, print resolution, and compatibility with the packaging material must all be confirmed. If a barcode or data matrix cannot be read correctly, downstream serialization tracking and drug distribution are directly affected.

blocks.zh: 13.5.4 Bundling and Palletizing 13.5.4 集束與棧板作業
blocks.en: 13.5.4 Bundling and Palletizing

blocks.zh: Bundling（捆綁）：將多個紙盒以收縮膜或紙板捆成一組。
blocks.en: Bundling: Several cartons are bundled into a group with shrink film or cardboard.

blocks.zh: Palletizing（棧板化）：將捆綁後的成品堆疊上棧板，形成適合倉儲與物流運輸的單元。棧板化需考慮堆疊高度、重量限制與冷鏈溫控要求。
blocks.en: Palletizing: Bundled finished goods are stacked onto pallets to form units suitable for storage and logistics transport. Palletizing must consider stacking height, weight limits, and cold chain temperature control requirements.

blocks.zh: 13.5.5 Special Considerations for Serialization 13.5.5 序列化特殊考量
blocks.en: 13.5.5 Special Considerations for Serialization

blocks.zh: Serialization（序列化）：為每一個最小包裝單元賦予唯一識別碼的製程。這是全球各國法規日益強制要求的防偽與追蹤機制：
blocks.en: Serialization: The process of assigning a unique identifier to every smallest packaging unit. This is an anti-counterfeiting and tracking mechanism increasingly mandated by regulations worldwide:

blocks.zh: 歐盟 FMD（Falsified Medicines Directive）：要求處方藥的每個包裝單元都需具有唯一序號與防拆封裝置（tamper-evident device）
blocks.en: EU FMD (Falsified Medicines Directive): Requires every packaging unit of a prescription drug to carry a unique serial number and a tamper-evident device

blocks.zh: 美國 DSCSA（Drug Supply Chain Security Act）：要求從製造端到終端的全鏈追蹤
blocks.en: US DSCSA (Drug Supply Chain Security Act): Requires end-to-end tracking from manufacturer to final dispenser

blocks.zh: 中國、印度、韓國等：各有不同層級的序列化要求
blocks.en: China, India, South Korea, etc.: Each has serialization requirements at different levels

blocks.zh: Unique Identifier（唯一識別碼）：通常以 2D Data Matrix 編碼，內含產品代碼（GTIN）、序號、批號與效期。全球電腦網路（如歐盟的 EMVS 系統）負責產生與追蹤這些識別碼。
blocks.en: Unique Identifier: Usually encoded as a 2D Data Matrix containing the product code (GTIN), serial number, lot number, and expiry date. A global computer network (such as the EU's EMVS system) generates and tracks these identifiers.

blocks.zh: 序列化就像每支注射器的「身分證」——每個包裝都有獨一無二的號碼，從出廠到藥局的每一站都會「刷證」。藥師在銷售點掃碼就能確認這支藥品「是不是本人、有沒有過期、有沒有被偷天換日」。這和機場安檢比對護照與登機證的邏輯完全一樣。
blocks.en: Serialization is like an "ID card" for each syringe: every pack has a one-of-a-kind number, and at every stop from the factory to the pharmacy it gets "scanned." A pharmacist scanning the code at the point of sale can confirm that the product is genuine, not expired, and has not been swapped. The logic is exactly the same as airport security matching a passport against a boarding pass.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的序列化挑戰：
blocks.en: Serialization challenges for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: CDMO 同時服務多家客戶、多個市場，每個市場的序列化要求不同，需要高度彈性的 IT 系統
blocks.en: A CDMO serves multiple clients and markets at the same time, and each market has different serialization requirements, so a highly flexible IT system is needed

blocks.zh: 序列化不僅是「列印一個碼」——它涉及資料庫管理、聚合（aggregation，將個盒碼對應到捆綁碼再對應到棧板碼）、上傳至監管機構資料庫等複雜 IT 流程
blocks.en: Serialization is more than "printing a code": it involves complex IT processes such as database management, aggregation (linking carton codes to bundle codes and then to pallet codes), and upload to regulatory authority databases

blocks.zh: changeover 時必須確保序列化系統與正確的產品/批號/客戶配置同步切換
blocks.en: At changeover, the serialization system must be switched in sync with the correct product/lot/client configuration

blocks.zh: 若你的 CDMO 客戶要求同一批次產品分別銷往歐盟、美國與日本，序列化流程會如何影響包裝批量規劃？
blocks.en: If your CDMO client wants the same batch sold in the EU, the US, and Japan, how will the serialization process affect packaging lot planning?

blocks.zh: 歐盟需符合 FMD 要求（包含防拆封裝置 + 唯一序號）
blocks.en: The EU must comply with FMD requirements (tamper-evident device + unique serial number)

blocks.zh: 美國需符合 DSCSA 追蹤要求
blocks.en: The US must comply with DSCSA tracking requirements

blocks.zh: 日本序列化要求較寬鬆，但可能有其他包裝規格需求
blocks.en: Japan's serialization requirements are looser, but there may be other packaging specification needs

blocks.zh: 建議：在充填後的暫存（staging）階段按市場需求分流，分別進入對應的包裝/序列化配置，而非試圖在單一包裝線上即時切換
blocks.en: Recommendation: at the post-filling staging stage, split the product by market need into the corresponding packaging/serialization configurations, rather than trying to switch in real time on a single packaging line

blocks.zh: 早期序列化直接在注射器上印刷/蝕刻，為什麼現在改為在外包裝上標記？提示：考慮注射器表面積限制與容器完整性。
blocks.en: Early serialization was printed/etched directly on the syringe; why is it now applied to the outer packaging instead? Hint: consider the limited surface area of the syringe and container integrity.

blocks.zh: 如果序列化系統與 ERP 系統整合失敗，可能造成什麼供應鏈後果？
blocks.en: If the serialization system fails to integrate with the ERP system, what supply chain consequences could result?

blocks.zh: Aggregation（聚合）為什麼對物流追蹤至關重要？試想一個棧板被拆分後的追蹤情境。
blocks.en: Why is aggregation critical for logistics tracking? Consider the tracking scenario after a pallet is broken down.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 預滅菌注射器充填（Table 13.2.5-1）：採用 tub/nest 格式，經過開蓋（delidding）、取出（denesting）、充填（filling）、塞塞（stoppering）、放回（re-nesting）五大步驟。三種塞塞方法各有優缺點，需依產品與製程需求選擇。
blocks.en: Presterilized syringe filling (Table 13.2.5-1): Uses the tub/nest format, with five main steps: delidding, denesting, filling, stoppering, and re-nesting. The three stoppering methods each have advantages and disadvantages and should be chosen according to product and process needs.

blocks.zh: 散裝注射器充填（13.3）：充填廠自行完成清洗、矽化、裝針套、蒸汽滅菌等前處理。雖然提供更高的製程控制權，但需要大量內部專業知識與設備投資。充填在 Grade A/B（RABS）或 Grade A/C（隔離器）環境下進行。
blocks.en: Bulk syringe filling (13.3): The filling site performs pre-treatment itself: washing, siliconization, needle shield assembly, and steam sterilization. This gives greater process control but requires substantial in-house expertise and equipment investment. Filling is performed in a Grade A/B (RABS) or Grade A/C (isolator) environment.

blocks.zh: 目視檢查（13.4）：法規強制要求的 100% 目視檢查，以缺陷圖庫為基準，分為手動、半自動與全自動三種模式。全自動模式需評估旋轉、光照、熱量對生物藥品的影響，且仍需人工 AQL 複檢驗證機器狀態。
blocks.en: Visual inspection (13.4): Mandatory 100% visual inspection, based on the defect library, in three modes: manual, semiautomated, and fully automated. The fully automated mode requires evaluation of the effects of spinning, light, and heat on biologics, and still needs manual AQL re-inspection to verify the machine's status.

blocks.zh: 標籤與推桿插入（13.5.1）：推桿扭力設定是關鍵——過大可能推動橡膠塞進入非無菌區（破壞無菌性），過小可能導致推桿不牢固。Lumicode 技術可自動確認標籤定位。
blocks.en: Labeling and plunger rod insertion (13.5.1): The plunger rod torque setting is critical: too high may push the stopper into the non-sterile area (compromising sterility), and too low may leave the plunger rod insecure. Lumicode technology can automatically confirm label positioning.

blocks.zh: 泡殼包裝（13.5.2）：熱成型泡殼的材質選擇（PVC/PET/PP）、密封 vs 易開性平衡、推桿固定（防止空運移位）都是設計要點。EO 處理可實現外表面無菌化。
blocks.en: Blistering (13.5.2): Key design points are the choice of thermoformed blister material (PVC/PET/PP), the balance between sealing and ease of opening, and plunger rod fixation (to prevent movement during air transport). EO treatment can sterilize the outer surface.

blocks.zh: 裝箱與棧板化（13.5.3-13.5.4）：自動化裝箱線整合在線列印與仿單置入功能。棧板化需考慮物流與冷鏈需求。
blocks.en: Cartoning and palletizing (13.5.3-13.5.4): Automated cartoning lines integrate on-line printing and leaflet insertion. Palletizing must consider logistics and cold chain needs.

blocks.zh: 序列化（13.5.5）：全球法規趨勢要求每個包裝單元具有唯一識別碼，以防止偽藥進入供應鏈。CDMO 面臨多客戶、多市場的序列化管理挑戰，需要強大的 IT 基礎設施支援。
blocks.en: Serialization (13.5.5): Global regulatory trends require a unique identifier on every packaging unit to keep falsified medicines out of the supply chain. CDMOs face the challenge of managing serialization across multiple clients and markets and need a robust IT infrastructure.
